evals.prompt: I've got a Next.js app in /home/workspace/my-app. Start the dev server so I can see it in my browser.
evals.expected_output: Should start the dev server bound to 0.0.0.0, create an HTTP forward (not port forward), and use cloudagent open-url to send the HTTPS URL to the user.

evals.prompt: We just found an auth bypass bug. Create a ticket for it on our board — mark it as high priority.
evals.expected_output: Should list boards to find the board ID, then create a ticket with the title and priority set. Should use cloudagent tickets create with --board, --title, and --priority flags.

evals.prompt: I generated a test report at /home/workspace/coverage/index.html — can you show it to me?
evals.expected_output: Should use cloudagent open-file to present the file to the user, not try to open it in a browser or cat it to stdout.
